name: Palia – Elderwoods Artifacts Bundle
description: The Elderwoods artifacts of Palia, by collection and artifact. Each piece is placed in its bundle once.

items.name: Ancient Statue 1
items.description: The base of an ancient statue, made of Flow-infused whitestone. Ancient Human stoneworkers designed their craft to last the test of time. An artifact from the Ancient Human Era. 1 of 3 pieces.

items.name: Ancient Statue 2
items.description: The body of an ancient statue. Without seeing the face, it's hard to determine what creature it depicts. An artifact from the Ancient Human Era. 2 of 3 pieces.

items.name: Ancient Statue 3
items.description: The head of an ancient statue. It appears to be carved in the image of a kitsuu. An artifact from the Ancient Human Era. 3 of 3 pieces.

items.name: Ancient Drum Toy
items.description: If you hold it in the middle and twist it back and forth, the little cord strikes the drum and makes a noise. If you do it at night, your neighbors will ask you to please stop because they're trying to sleep. An artifact from the Ancient Human Era.

items.name: Ancient Machine 1
items.description: The base of some Ancient Human thing. If you can't find the rest of the pieces, it'd still work as a stand for your most prized plush. An artifact from the Ancient Human Era. 1 of 5 pieces.

items.name: Ancient Machine 2
items.description: Part of some Ancient Human thing. No idea what the thing is supposed to be, however. An artifact from the Ancient Human Era. 2 of 5 pieces.

items.name: Ancient Machine 3
items.description: Part of some Ancient Human thing. This is the right part of it, but if you turn it around, it could also be the left. An artifact from the Ancient Human Era. 3 of 5 pieces.

items.name: Ancient Machine 4
items.description: Pieces for some Ancient Human thing. There are lots of Ancient Human things scattered across the island of Bahari, and these are certainly some of them. An artifact from the Ancient Human Era. 4 of 5 pieces.

items.name: Ancient Machine 5
items.description: Pieces for some Ancient Human thing. Even if you found the rest of the pieces, what this Thing is would remain unclear. An artifact from the Ancient Human Era. 5 of 5 pieces.

items.name: Ancient Necklace 1
items.description: One half of a necklace. It appears to depict the Phoenix. An artifact from the Ancient Human Era. 1 of 2 pieces.

items.name: Ancient Necklace 2
items.description: One half of a necklace. The gems inlaid remind you of Earth and Fire. An artifact from the Ancient Human Era. 2 of 2 pieces.

items.name: Ancient Galdur Toy
items.description: It's unclear what purpose, if any, this little toy served. Sometimes things don't need a reason to be cute. An artifact from the Ancient Human Era.

items.name: Umbraan Lute 1
items.description: The body of some kind of instrument. The only sound it makes now is a sad "twang" when you jostle it. An artifact from the Umbraan Era. 1 of 2 pieces.

items.name: Umbraan Lute 2
items.description: One might mistake this for some sort of weapon. In the hands of an unskilled musician that might even be true. An artifact from the Umbraan Era. 2 of 2 pieces.

items.name: Umbraan Thing
items.description: The use of this strange... thing is unclear to anyone but an Umbraan- and unfortunately, there are very few of them left in the Elderwood to ask. An artifact from the Umbraan Era.

items.name: Umbraan Dress 1
items.description: This skirt is woven from local Elderwood materials, but the stones embedded within are not. An artifact from the Umbraan Era. 1 of 3 pieces.

items.name: Umbraan Dress 2
items.description: A craftsperson put quite a lot of time and care into weaving this garment. The fabric is whisper-thin, yet withstands quite a bit of pressure when struck. An artifact from the Umbraan Era. 2 of 3 pieces.

items.name: Umbraan Dress 3
items.description: The stones within this headdress resonate bright in the presence of Flow. An artifact from the Umbraan Era. 3 of 3 pieces.

items.name: Umbraan Pot
items.description: This pot is clearly too small to cook with, but it might work in a pinch if you need to defend yourself. An artifact from the Umbraan Era.

items.name: Umbraan Painting 1
items.description: One third of a painting. It appears to depict a regal Umbraan in repose. An artifact from the Umbraan Era. 1 of 3 pieces.

items.name: Umbraan Painting 2
items.description: One third of a painting. The creature depicted within is unknown in Palian society. An artifact from the Umbraan Era. 2 of 3 pieces.

items.name: Umbraan Painting 3
items.description: One third of a painting. While there is nothing particularly interesting in this piece of the puzzle, the painting would look pretty silly without it there. An artifact from the Umbraan Era. 3 of 3 pieces.

items.name: Wartorn Sword 1
items.description: Is a scabbard without a sword still a scabbard? An artifact from the Wartorn Era. 1 of 2 pieces.

items.name: Wartorn Sword 2
items.description: The good news is that a sword without a scabbard is still definitively a sword. Just one you need to be extra careful putting away. An artifact from the Wartorn Era. 2 of 2 pieces.

items.name: Wartorn Horn 1
items.description: A piece of some kind of horn, or a very sturdy photograph. An artifact from the Wartorn Era. 1 of 2 pieces.

items.name: Wartorn Horn 2
items.description: No need to toot your own horn- you can toot this one instead. Unfortunately, without its other half, the toot produced is decidedly sad. An artifact from the Wartorn Era. 2 of 2 pieces.

items.name: Wartorn Banner 1
items.description: A handheld stand, intended to hold something at the top. Could be used as a bludgeon in a pinch. An artifact from the Wartorn Era. 1 of 3 pieces.

items.name: Wartorn Banner 2
items.description: The upper half of an old banner. Could be used as a tablecloth in a pinch. An artifact from the Wartorn Era. 2 of 3 pieces.

items.name: Wartorn Banner 3
items.description: The lower half of an old banner. Could be used as a cape in a pinch. An artifact from the Wartorn Era. 3 of 3 pieces.

items.name: Wartorn Creature
items.description: Elouisa insists these creatures made of stone are proof of ancient majiri ancestors. Caleri insists there was clearly a scam artist living in the Elderwood creating archaeological fakes to trick unwitting people. The truth is out there. An artifact from the Wartorn Era.

items.name: Wartorn Mermaid
items.description: This strange creature appears to be part fish, part miniature Majiri, and 100% fake. Elouisa has fondly dubbed it the "Inyrevyn Mermaid". An artifact from the Wartorn Era.
